title: A world's imported assets, an import's body and a file named before it is sent v1 (world.assets.v1, world.asset.import.v1, world.asset.upload.v1)
about: What the editor's asset browser lists and what an import answers (GitHub #13420): the world, its import pack's SHA-256 and size, the limits shown before a file is sent, the licences an import may declare, and each asset of the pack with the file it came from. And world.asset.import.v1: an import's body, a line that names the licence and the file, then the file's bytes. The route that packs an import writes the list and reads the body; the editor's shell reads the list and writes the body's line. And world.asset.upload.v1: where the server takes a file by direct upload (the API), the ask that names a file by its SHA-256 before it is sent, said again when it is sent, and the answer that says where the bytes go or that storage has them.
